decisions.reason: As a system accessory tied to the firm’s established track offering, it likely has low carrying cost and preserves option value by supporting the installed base and future system sales.
A LED luminaire sits in the firm’s core category, so despite limited recent evidence and a broad assortment, it is still worth keeping unless results have clearly disappointed.
A home automation server box is more costly to maintain and more exposed to technical obsolescence, so after several years the option is less attractive if strong market validation has not appeared.
A luminaire family ties up more assortment, display, and inventory resources, and with many nearby product options the firm would likely prune it if its success has remained uncertain by 2022.
